category: Phenomena of a Total Solar Eclipse
explanation: Corona, Diamond Ring, Baily's Beads, and Umbra are all specific terms or phenomena associated with a total solar eclipse. A Nebula is a vast cloud of gas and dust in space, a distinct astronomical object unrelated to an eclipse event.

category: Signatories of the U.S. Declaration of Independence
explanation: All listed individuals except George Washington were signatories of the United States Declaration of Independence. George Washington led the Continental Army but did not sign the document.
Meter, Second, Ampere, and Kelvin are all fundamental SI (International System of Units) base units. Liter is a unit of volume but is not an SI base unit; it is derived.
